list.title: Fee Structures
list.caption: Fee structures
list.subtitle: What each class pays for each fee.
list.emptyExplanation: Add your first fee structure and it will show up here.
list.noMatchMessage: No fee structures match these filters
list.noMatchExplanation: Try a different search, year, class or section, or clear the filters.

form.description: Fees are generated each month from the structures that match a student's class and academic year.
form.errorAmountRequired: Amount must be greater than zero
form.academicYearLocked: The academic year can't be changed later.

deleteDialog.title: Delete fee structure
deleteDialog.sideEffect: Fees already generated from this structure stay exactly as they are — nothing is removed or refunded. The structure just stops applying to future fee generation.
deleteDialog.conflictMessage: This fee structure can't be deleted because payments have already been recorded against the fees generated from it.

help.name: Name shown in the list and on bills, for example Monthly tuition; up to 100 characters.
help.feeType: The kind of fee, for example Monthly tuition or Exam fee. Once any bill uses this structure the type can no longer change.
help.amount: Amount per student; more than 0, up to two decimals. A change applies only to bills created afterwards, not to existing bills.
help.academicYear: The academic year this fee belongs to. Chosen only when creating; it cannot change later.
help.class: The class this fee is for; leave empty for the whole school. It is a label only; generating bills charges whoever you pick.
help.section: One section of the class; leave empty for all sections of the class. Pick a class first.
